RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel’s demographic composition alone does not indicate discrimination; selection panels typically reflect existing hospital leadership, clinical governance, and HR availability. For a laboratory head position, broad administrative leadership and people management are frequently prioritized over higher academic degrees such as a PhD.

Alleging bias without concrete evidence—such as inappropriate interview remarks or documented procedural breaches—is legally unsubstantiated and would severely damage your professional reputation. A two-week wait for written feedback is standard institutional delay, not evasion. Send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on how your management experience compared to the role's requirements, keeping the focus entirely on professional qualifications.
